name: VoiceStudio
description: VoiceStudio is a local-first studio for voice synthesis, voice cloning, dubbing, transcription, and audiobook production. It provides a browser-based interface backed by a local API.

notes.text: Open http://<container-IP>:3900 and enter the API key stored in /opt/voicestudio_data/.env as OMNIVOICE_API_KEY.
Review and accept each model and dependency licence in VoiceStudio before downloading it.
CPU inference is slower; GPU passthrough and accelerator-specific setup are not configured automatically.

app_vars.name: var_voicestudio_hf_token
app_vars.label: Hugging Face Token (optional)
app_vars.help: Optional token for gated/private model repositories and higher download limits.
